# Slack Web API: team

## `slack api team-access-logs-list [options]`

- What: team\_accessLogs — read (GET /team.accessLogs)
- Call: `GET /team.accessLogs`, effect: read
- Sign-in: slackAuth (admin)

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--token <value>` | yes | Authentication token. Requires scope: \`admin\` |
| `--before <value>` | no | End of time range of logs to include in results (inclusive). |
| `--count <value>` | no | count |
| `--page <value>` | no | page |

## `slack api team-billable-info-list [options]`

- What: team\_billableInfo — read (GET /team.billableInfo)
- Call: `GET /team.billableInfo`, effect: read
- Sign-in: slackAuth (admin)

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--token <value>` | yes | Authentication token. Requires scope: \`admin\` |
| `--user <value>` | no | A user to retrieve the billable information for. Defaults to all users. |

## `slack api team-info-list [options]`

- What: team\_info — read (GET /team.info)
- Call: `GET /team.info`, effect: read
- Sign-in: slackAuth (team:read)

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--token <value>` | yes | Authentication token. Requires scope: \`team:read\` |
| `--team <value>` | no | Team to get info on, if omitted, will return information about the current team. Will only return team that the authenticated token is allowed to see through external shared channels |

## `slack api team-integration-logs-list [options]`

- What: team\_integrationLogs — read (GET /team.integrationLogs)
- Call: `GET /team.integrationLogs`, effect: read
- Sign-in: slackAuth (admin)

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--token <value>` | yes | Authentication token. Requires scope: \`admin\` |
| `--app-id <value>` | no | Filter logs to this Slack app. Defaults to all logs. |
| `--change-type <value>` | no | Filter logs with this change type. Defaults to all logs. |
| `--count <value>` | no | count |
| `--page <value>` | no | page |
| `--service-id <value>` | no | Filter logs to this service. Defaults to all logs. |
| `--user <value>` | no | Filter logs generated by this user’s actions. Defaults to all logs. |
